summary: Planned the adequacy half of the closure-indexed periodicity gate as one new wired evidence probe under specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/. The plan makes the research round's two open decisions itself rather than deferring them: the fulfilment condition is EXISTENTIAL (never a ULive transplant) and Route B (check a candidate realizable set) is chosen over Route A (decide generalized-Buchi nonemptiness). Six sequential phases build the existential until-fixpoint, its guarded-path characterization, a compiled separation of the universal and existential operators on a cycle with an exit, the chain-to-ray composition theorem, the certificate with its box and stab clauses present as checked biconditionals, and the compiled rejection of an ev-carrying cycle that local coherence accepts. The 18-theorem Lean Challenge block was compiled at plan time (exit 0, 18 sorries, no other diagnostic).
